hypothesis: A consequential-uncertainty duty after spec and test strategy, before defining work_items, improves final planning decisions or reduces consequential Plan Improve rework.
scope: Seeded planning component pilot, not a delivered-product or full E2E comparison.
models_are: Requested exact launch settings, not provider-side served-model attestation; no fallback.
deadline_scope: Study observation window only; no ShipLoop loop cap or stop-rule change. Deadline is incomplete evidence, never a pass.
failure_policy: Retain every attempt. No retry for poor subject performance, unsupported conclusions or subject stalls. On a verified infrastructure failure, retain the failed attempt, repair only apparatus, freeze a new registration if material, and rerun both arms of the affected matched cell. No score-dependent early stopping.
completion: Accepted plan plus matching real Plan Improve receipt and no later accepted result. Synthetic prelude receipts do not count. Incomplete and conditional outcomes are reported distinctly.
primary: Final plan fulfils the case obligations with supported consequential decisions and honest readiness.
secondary: Unsupported consequential commitments in first submitted plan
Timing and source of decision evidence
costs: Reported input and output tokens when complete
not_rewards: Static checklist conformance without outcome value
judgment: One arm-blinded bundle per initial judgment. Obligation grades 0 missed, 1 partial, 2 fulfilled, supported by exact quotes and evidence locators; independent paired review uses seeded order and separate fresh context. No subject or judge observes the arm mapping. Source inspection is valid evidence and the current flow may investigate early.
analysis: Descriptive paired outcomes over four constructed scenarios; no significance or generalized gain claim. Missing usage stays null. Any potential adoption requires separate confirmation, adverse-case review and exact-text validation.
isolation: Separate homes, workspaces and installed plugin trees; local-only fixtures. Codex shell is not OS-fenced to its workspace on this host. Audit transcript for cross-arm/operator access; contaminated samples are not valid comparative evidence.
changes_after_review: Plan Improve remains byte-identical in both arms
Duty placed after accepted-source reopening and before work_items
Shared allowance carried forward rather than reset
Require real Plan Improve completion; retain first seed_result and final result
concurrency_note: Preflight-only operational adjustment before measured subjects or scores: four independent local slices in balanced paired cohorts, with no fixed ports or shared product files. Runtime/token comparisons retain overlap limitations.
